senses.gloss: गण- + अधिपति गण- + अधिपति, m. Śiva, Śiś. 9, 27.
गण- + आभ्यन्तर गण- + आभ्यन्तर, m. the member of a corporation, MBh. 3, 154.
गण-ईशान गण-ईशान, Gaṇeśa, MBh. 1, 75.
गण- + ईश्वर गण- + ईश्वर, m. the chief of a troop, Rām. 4, 28, 22.
गण्ड-उपधान गण्ड-उपधान, n. a pillow, Suśr. 2, 41, 9.

गण् गण्, i. 10 (rather a denomin. derived from the next), गणय, Par. (also Ātm., Bhāg. P. 4, 7, 29).
 1. To number, MBh. 3, 2618.
 2. To value, MBh. 2, 1552.
 3. To impute, Bhartṛ. 2, 44.
 4. To regard, Pañc. 258, 21.
 गणित, Reckoned, MBh. 13, 4439; calculated, Lass. 37, 8. n. Arithmetic, MBh. 1, 293.
 --With the prep. अधि अधि, To praise, Bhāg. P. 1, 5, 21.
 --With अव अव, To disregard, to neglect, Pañc. 239, 2.
 --With परि परि,
 1. To count over, Suśr. 1, 334, 8 (परिगण्य, instead of the regular परिगणय्य).
 2. To consider, Megh. 5.
 अ-परिगणित, adj. Innumerable, Bhāg. P. 6, 9, 35.
 --With प्र प्र, To calculate, MBh. 1, 6808.
 --With वि वि,
 1. To number, Rām. 3, 53, 11.
 2. To consider, Rām. 3, 44, 31.
 3. To disregard, Pañc. iii. d. 40.

गण गण, m.
 1. A multitude, Rām. 5, 91, 1.
 2. A class, Man. 1, 22.
 3. Troops of inferior deities, considered as Śiva's attendants, and under the especial superintendence of Gaṇeśa, Rām. 5, 89, 7.
 4. A community, Yājñ. 2, 187.
 5. A contemptible association, Man. 4, 209.
 6. A body of troops consisting of 3 gulmas: i. e. 27 chariots, 27 elephants, 81 horses, and 135 foot, MBh. 1, 291.
 7. A foot of a verse, Śrut. 5, Br.
 --Comp.

गणक गण् + अक, m.
 1. A calculator, [] MBh. 15, 417.
 2. An astrologer, Rām. 1, 12, 7.
गणत्व गण + त्व, n. The condition of an attendant of Śiva, Kathās. 7, 110.
गणदीक्षिन् गणदीक्षिन्, i. e. गण-दीक्षा + इन्, adj. m. A priest who officiates for a community, Yājñ. 1, 161.

गणन गण् + अन, n. and f. ना.
 1. Counting, Pañc. pr. d. 7.
 2. Calculation, settlement, Rājat. 5, 237.
 3. Annumerating, Ragh. 8, 94.
 4. Consideration, Daśak. in Chr. 188, 9.
 5. Regard, Rājat. 5, 308.
गणशस् गण + शस्, adv. By troops, Daśak. in. Chr. 183, 14.
गणश्री गणश्री, i. e. गण-श्रि, adj. United in troops, Chr. 290, 9 = Rigv. i. 64, 9.
गणिका गणिका, i. e. गण + क, f. A harlot, Man. 4, 209.

गणिन् गणिन्, i. e. गण + इन्, adj. Having troops.
 --Comp.
गणेय गण् + एय, an anomal. participle of the fut. pass. of गण् (f. यी), Numerable; in अ-, adj. Innumerable, MBh. 8, 2554.

गणेश गणेश, i. e. गण-ईश, m.
 1. A name of Śiva, MBh. 3, 1629.
 2. Ganeśa, the son of Śiva and Pārvatī, god of wisdom, MBh. 1, 74.
गणेश गणेश. 3. a chief of the Nāgas, or serpents.
† गण्ड् गण्ड्, i. 1, Par. To be a cheek; cf. the next, and MBh. 13, 4499.

गण्ड गण्ड,
 I. m.
 1. A cheek, Megh. 27.
 2. A boil, Suśr. 1, 283, 8.
 3. A bronchocele, Suśr. 1, 288, 15.
 II. f. डा, A proper name, MBh. 13, 4417.
 --Comp.

गण्डक गण्डक,
 I. m. A name of the inhabitants of Videha, derived from the river Gaṇḍakī, MBh. 2, 1062.
 II. f. की, The name of a river, MBh. 2, 794.
 --Comp.
गण्डु गण्डु (akin to गण्ड), m. and f. A pillow, Pañc. 126, 2.

गण्डूष गण्डूष (akin to गण्ड), m. and f. षा.
 1. A mouthful, Daśak. in Chr. 194, 5 (of honey); MBh. 8, 2051 (of onions).
 2. A mouthful of water for rinsing the mouth with, Bhāg. P. 9, 15, 3.
 3. The tip of an elephant's trunk, Kumāras. 3, 37.
गाणपत्य गाणपत्य, i. e. गण-पति + य, n. Dominion over the inferior deities, or the condition of Gaṇeśa, MBh. 3, 4093.
गाण्डिव गाण्डिव, or गाण्डीव गाण्ड्-ईव [] (cf. the next), m. and n. The bow of Arjuna, MBh. 3, 228; 1, 8177.
गाण्डीव गाण्डीव, see गाण्डिव.
गाण्डीमय गाण्डी + मय, adj. Made of gāṇḍī (a plant?), MBh. 5, 3540.
गाण्डीविन् गाण्डीविन्, i. e. गाण्डीव + इन्, m. A name of Arjuna, MBh. 13, 6898.
गण- + द्वीप गण- + द्वीप, m. the name of an island (?), Rām. 4, 40, 33.
गण- + पति गण- + पति, and गणना-, m. [] a name of Gaṇeśa, Pañc. i. d. 175; Rājat. 5, 26.
गण- + भर्तृ गण- + भर्तृ, m. epithet of Śiva, Kir. 5, 42.
गण्ड- + भेदक गण्ड- + भेदक, m. a cutpurse, Śāk. 74, 14 (Prākṛ.).
गण्ड- + मालिन् गण्ड- + मालिन्, adj. sbst. one who has the erysipelas, Man. 3, 161.
गण्ड-शिला गण्ड-शिला, f. a large rock, Bhāg. P. 3, 13, 22.
गण्ड- + स्थल गण्ड- + स्थल, n., and f. ली, 1. the cheek, Śṛṅgārat. 7 (ल); Daśak. in Chr. 199, 2 (ली). 2. an elephant's temple, Pañc. i. d. 139.
